heroHeadline: Day 91 of Op Ghazab — Taliban Releases TOLOnews Journalists on Bail; Russia Declares 'Full Partnership' With Taliban at SCO Moscow; 22-Day Strike Pause; Jawid Niazi Day 21 in Detention
heroSubtitle: On May 27, 2026 (Day 91 of Operation Ghazab lil-Haq), Taliban authorities released TOLO News presenter Mansoor Niazi (Day 20) and political editor Imran Danish (Day 18) on bail — ending their detention after 20 and 18 days respectively in Taliban General Directorate of Intelligence (GDI) custody. Both journalists face trial after Eid al-Adha; charges have not been publicly announced. Paigard News Agency director Jawid (Ahmad Jawed) Niazi remains in Taliban custody (Day 21), with no bail granted and no charges filed. On Day 90 (May 26), Taliban Defense Minister Mohammad Yaqoob Mujahid traveled to Moscow for the SCO Security Heads Meeting, where Russia publicly declared a 'full-fledged partnership' with Taliban-ruled Afghanistan — the most explicit Russian-Taliban strategic alignment since the August 2021 takeover. The 22-day pause in confirmed Pakistani cross-border airstrikes into Afghanistan since the May 5 Dangam (Kunar) strike continues to hold. Pakistan's IBO campaign through May: 22+ killed in Shewa (May 17-20), Afghan commander Basir killed in Arjam Kali (May 20), 4 including wanted commander Tor Saqib in Spinwam (May 21), 11 in Datta Khel (May 24, internationally confirmed by Xinhua May 25). UN OHCHR on May 25 warned forced returns to Afghanistan expose deportees to 'serious risks of persecution.' Pakistan has expelled over 146,000 Afghans in 2026 alone. WFP warned of worsening hunger crisis with 4.9 million mothers and children affected. No formal ceasefire; no Urumqi Round 2 date; China silent on mediation since April 8.
